request.description: Refine this exact stone weir-keeper boss torso into beautiful restrained native pixel art at the SAME 120x112 size. Keep this object identity and topology: old abandoned garden sluice gate that stood up, left tall slotted gate tower, lower broken right tower, wide outboard shoulders, central chest of heavy horizontal sluice slabs around recessed diamond heart socket, narrow crest notch for separately drawn head, two short piers with dark culvert arch between feet. NO head, NO fists, NO arms, NO crystals, NO glow, NO cyan, NO water. Make its MASS sculptural: large quiet stone planes, deep right side returns, thick stone top surfaces, deeply recessed collar and socket, strong hard planar bevels with lit upper-left plane and dark right returns. Sparse named structural chips, no speckle or hatching. Dusty cold slate and ash mauve stone, a few chalk edges, near-black purple crevices, subtle dry moss in one seam. Preserve composition, width, ground feet at y107, heart socket exactly center x60 y49, collar center x60 y34, left crystal seat x24 y9, right crystal seat x96 y9. Read as ancient architectural mass rather than a flat robot. Keep clear dark hue-tinted outline and fully opaque or fully transparent native pixels. Deep relief must read at 1x. Transparent background and generous transparent margin; nothing touches canvas edges.
